entries.name: Raspberry Pi 3 Model A+

entries.name: BETAFPV SuperD 2.4 GHz ExpressLRS Receiver

They do not numerically dimension the header centers, first-post offset or exact pitch; no matched board CAD was found. The approximate 2.54 mm carrier and a supplied generic four-pin strip are insufficient to certify the installed post map.

entries.name: RadioMaster ER4 ExpressLRS PWM Receiver
entries.reason: The manufacturer confirms 2.54 mm contacts, but the ER4 mating face is a complete two-column six-position servo connector, not two long breadboard strips. CH1 and CH2 occupy an adjacent pair; so do CH3 and CH4 at the opposite end. Both contacts of each adjacent pair would join one breadboard conductor, while a quarter turn would join PWM, servo supply and ground down a column. The full connector cannot straddle the breadboard trench at its 2.54 mm inter-column gap. Factory posts face sideways, and EXT-V is a separate rear wire pad. Use cables or a receiver adapter; do not omit servo channels to force fitting.

entries.name: SpeedyBee F405 WING MINI
entries.reason: The SpeedyBee F405 WING MINI manual distinguishes the flight/power boards, angled servo banks, cable sockets and rear solder alternatives. A correct physical view must retain all 105 published contacts, include the actual lower-board and connector clearances, and locate complete selected banks without shorting adjacent servo/supply nets. The published stack envelope and off-board wiring carrier do not provide the complete numerical post/phase map. Keep this as a specific assembly-map candidate, not a rejection of all 2.54 mm parts.

entries.name: Matek F405-WING-V2
entries.reason: Matek explicitly supplies 2.54 mm Dupont pins with this unsoldered V2 board, so the pitch itself is not a compatibility exclusion. The source identifies 54 × 36 × 13 mm overall dimensions and 30.5 mm mounting centers, but not exact first-post offsets or all inter-bank phases. Dense fully populated servo banks would share independent supply/signal contacts on breadboard strips. A header-only installation could be reviewed after exact CAD/assembly and all 87 endpoint projections are resolved; the current off-board carrier cannot establish it.

entries.name: Waveshare SN65HVD230 CAN Board

A straight 2.54 mm replacement is plausible but neither its nominal post pitch nor its PCB-hole/clearance map is established by this source. entries.name: GOWIN DK_PCIE_GW5ART-LV15MG132P_V1.1
entries.reason: The V1.1 PCIe card uses 0.4 mm C-PHY and 0.5 mm D-PHY connectors and a two-row P8 LVDS header. The manual prints 2.5 mm for the named TST-106-01-G-D header; do not round that text into an insertion proof. entries.name: GOWIN DK_PCIE_GW5AT-LV60UG324_V1.1
entries.reason: The V1.1 card combines PCIe, fine-pitch ADC/FPC, two 2×10 MIPI banks at 2.0 mm and a 2×10 GPIO bank at 2.54 mm. The latter is still two adjacent rows with independent nets; its 2.54 mm pitch does not make the whole card directly breadboard-compatible.

entries.name: GOWIN DK_START_GW5A-LV25LQ144_V1.0
entries.reason: The V1.0 board uses 2.0 mm PH LVDS interfaces and double-row 2.54 mm GPIO banks J29/J30, alongside LVDS FPC sockets. Complete double-row GPIO headers cannot straddle an ordinary breadboard trench without independent signals sharing conductors. A single UART/service-bank assembly would need separate source mapping and clearance review.

entries.name: GOWIN DK_START_GW5AT-LV60PG484A_V1.2
entries.reason: The exact V1.2 manual and change notice distinguish its separate J12/J18 MIPI banks from the earlier 80-contact connector. It retains 2×10 LVDS banks at 2.0 mm, a 2×7 GPIO bank at 2.54 mm and a 2×2 ADC bank. Neither the nonstandard pitch nor the dense multirow patterns are direct whole-board breadboard posts.

entries.name: GOWIN DK_VIDEO_GW5AT-LV60UG225_V1.0
entries.reason: This V1.0 product is a core-plus-carrier kit. Its two 80-contact 0.5 mm board-to-board interfaces, 0.5 mm FPC and ultra-fine coaxial ports are mating sockets, not downward breadboard leads. CORE and IO contact namespaces must remain distinct; scaling the composite carrier drawing cannot produce an insertion profile.

entries.name: GOWIN DK_USB_GW5ART-LV15MG132P_V1.1
entries.reason: The V1.1 USB kit exposes an 80-contact 0.5 mm MIPI socket, a 2×10 2.0 mm MIPI header, complete SPI/control banks and coaxial SDI ports. The primary high-speed interfaces require an adapter. Small monitor/status headers remain candidates only after their exact source post plane and underside clearance are reviewed.

entries.name: GOWIN DK_START_GW5AT-LV60PG484A_V1.1

entries.name: Trenz Electronic TEC0117-01
entries.reason: Manufacturer revision-01 STEP supplies PCB, micro-USB and switch body bounds, all 46 plated-hole centers, and 2.54 mm main pitch. Trenz/Gowin explicitly declare Arduino MKR compatibility; the MKR breadboard grid establishes nominal 20.32 mm installed-post separation. Exported main drill columns are X=.23899876/20.56026622 mm, separation 20.32126746; the nominal right posts differ by only .00126746 mm within 1 mm drills. No global fitting tolerance is widened. Exact front/back photographs identify both main pin-1 markers, all six J4 holes and both J6 rows. The declared configuration matches the source photographs with J4/J6 bodies unpopulated, so their actual plated holes are exposed; the optional right-angle Pmod socket in STEP is not fitted. All 46 endpoints remain present, with no substituted cable landings or hidden auxiliary terminals.

entries.name: Sipeed Maix Bit V2.0 (MEMS microphone)
entries.reason: Manufacturer Maix-BIT Specifications v2.0 explicitly specifies 2.54 mm GPIO contacts, a 53.3 x 25.4 mm PCB and direct breadboard insertion. The V2.0 component-side photographs and assembly identify both complete 18-contact rows with connector positions 10/11 replaced by the central mounting annulus. The nominal straight-header assembly uses 22.86 mm row separation and 2.54 mm longitudinal post centres. Row separation and the 2.54 mm first-post offset are a documented nominal assembly inference corroborated by the manufacturer direct-insertion statement and the same-side photographs; these are not claimed to be extracted production STEP drill coordinates. Non-contact hardware remains representative.

entries.name: Sipeed Maix M1s Dock 3272
entries.reason: Manufacturer M1s_Dock_3272.html iBOM: P5/P6 each have sixteen 1 mm drilled contacts at X=76.7/99.56 mm and Y=-114.6+i*2.54 mm. Mirror X into the published module-shield-side orientation, preserving P6 left/P5 right and 22.86 mm separation. PCB envelope is X=74.43..101.83, Y=-122.14..-66.74 mm. All four P7 underside SMD terminal centres (1.25 mm pitch) are projected separately with BACK PAD markers; P7 is not an insertion header. Non-contact hardware remains illustrative.

entries.name: Sipeed Maix M0sense 30215
entries.reason: Manufacturer M0Sense_30215_ibom.html: J3 inner round THT centres X=139.1666 and J2 inner centres X=154.4068 mm, Y=92.199+i*2.54 mm, 0.9 mm drills. The PCB edge coordinates are X=137.5762..156 and Y=89.5..113.3 mm. Use the inner drilled holes rather than the outer castellations. The 0.0002 mm exported row discrepancy is retained in this audit; straight male posts use the nominal 15.24 mm separation within these drilled holes. PCB and pin numbering follow the component-side iBOM; non-contact hardware remains illustrative.

entries.name: Sipeed Maix II Dock 3072
entries.reason: Resolved against exact manufacturer 3072 TOP DXF. Its two complete HN1X10 header blocks have X=-14.49999894/+14.49999894 mm, separation 28.99999788 mm; Y=-14.13499586+i*2.54 mm, ten positions. Longitudinal pitch is compatible, but 29 mm row separation is not an integer multiple of 2.54 mm (nearest 27.94/30.48 mm). This is a genuine full-pattern mismatch; scaling the PCB or widening the fit tolerance would misrepresent the hardware. Use an adapter or jumpers.

entries.name: LILYGO T3 LoRa32 V1.6.1 SX1276
entries.reason: The manufacturer general T3 V1.6 STEP establishes 26 main centers at 2.54 mm pitch and 22.86 mm spacing, and the 27.1272 x 64.4652 mm PCB. The separately published mechanical DWG is V1.6.2, while this catalog entry follows exact V1.6.1/20210104 electrical and photo evidence. The V1.6 STEP omits the fitted battery socket contact metal. A complete exact-revision auxiliary map and the side/orientation agreement between this assembled STEP and the component-side V1.6.1 photo are not established. The board is not rejected for its nominal header pitch; this remains a mechanical-source gap.

entries.name: LILYGO T3-S3 V1.3 SX1262

Physical 1.0 mm auxiliary solder pads, P2 battery tails and 2.0 mm J3 solar drills are read from package artwork, not logical SYM_TERMINAL text. The matching 20250110 photo establishes functions and polarities. Stable U4 battery IDs are retained even though CAD calls that socket P2.

entries.name: LILYGO T-A7670X V1.4 (ESP32)

entries.name: FriendlyElec NanoPi R2S

entries.name: NXP FRDM-KL25Z (Rev E)
entries.reason: The Rev E KL25Z has four double-row Arduino-compatible expansion banks with sixty-four contacts. Within-bank 2.54 mm pitch does not turn the complete 2-row field into two breadboard-straddling strips: adjacent independent signals would share a terminal conductor, and the UNO bank layout is not one complete breadboard grid. The auxiliary debug interface is a fine-pitch keyed header. The old canonical Rev E schematic URL now returns 404; the accessible manufacturer SCH-27556 PDF is Rev D, so it is retained only as family corroboration and is not substituted for exact Rev E mechanical CAD. Use shield/debug cables or an adapter; any future auxiliary-only insertion needs its own explicit complete view.
